MINI-MINUTES FOR JUL-31-2007 9:30 AM FOR DEPT 301

LAW AND MOTION, 301, ARGUED AND THE COURT ADOPTED IT'S TENTATIVE RULING AS FOLLOWS: DEFENDANT DORIS LESLIE'S PETITION FOR RELIEF AGAINST FORFEITURE OF LEASE IS DENIED. DEFENDANT HAD A LONG UNEXCUSABLE HISTORY OF NOT PAYING RENT EVEN BEFORE HER CURRENT MEDICAL HARDSHIP AND HER MOTION IS NOT PREMISED ON FULL PAYMENT OF THE BACK RENT. ORDER SIGNED IN OPEN COURT. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR 8189.
